# llmdojo

> Scored tooling katas, habit rules, and pre-baked warm-start sessions for LLM coding agents

## Modules

- [llmdojo.ipyaidojo](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmdojo/ipyaidojo.html.md): Start ipyai with a worked tooling session already in its history
- [llmdojo.tmpl](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmdojo/tmpl.html.md): The template layer shared by claudedojo and codexdojo
